problem: Intermittent native Qt abort during project auto-resume while media and timeline workers deliver events
cause: Production diagnostics monkey-patched QApplication.notify with Python; Qt invokes notify from worker QThreads too, and concurrent event delivery crossed the Python/Shiboken override. Administrative pacing reset also emitted curve_changed and started an unnecessary cut worker during project reload.
rule: Never monkey-patch QApplication.notify in production. Keep Qt dispatcher native; use independent main-thread heartbeat/freeze probes. Block user-action signals with QSignalBlocker during administrative project-state resets.
applies_to: PySide6 startup, project switching, background QThreads, UI diagnostics
